subject.title: fix: preserve skill proposals across apply crashes and workspace moves

question: Should this shared-state migration be accepted after reviewing an upgrade and crash-recovery proof for existing Skill Workshop state?
rationale: The code changes durable proposal ownership and recovery semantics across existing installations; the protected label and missing real upgrade evidence require a maintainer to decide whether the demonstrated migration boundary is sufficient.

options.title: Require upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted run that upgrades legacy proposal metadata with Doctor, moves an agent workspace, and recovers a deliberately interrupted apply before merge.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused migration and recovery tests if maintainers judge the existing automated coverage sufficient for this state transition.

recommendation.title: Require upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted run that upgrades legacy proposal metadata with Doctor, moves an agent workspace, and recovers a deliberately interrupted apply before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current persistence and migration proposal and is the available technical contact for its validation evidence.
